links.note: Choosing PVC over lead and graphite as the insulating coating requires knowing that metals conduct and that graphite is the conducting non-metal - the non-metal properties concept, exceptions included (115).
An acidic oxide A2O3 means A is a non-metal (115). Filed there because the acidic character of non-metal oxides has no concept of its own in this set; 118 covers only the amphoteric metal oxides.

Why pure water will not electrolyse while molten/ionic liquids and mercury conduct - conduction depends on free ions, which is the ionic-compound property concept (121). 126 is the refining application, mentioned only in the last clause.

Leads on zinc displacing copper because it stands higher in the activity series (119). The other two parts are silver tarnishing (127) and roasting a sulphide ore (125), so this item spans three concepts.
The weight of the item is part (b): electro-refining of copper with anode, cathode and electrolyte identified and a diagram (126). Part (a)'s one-word metal examples belong to 114.
